sections.title: Naming any unit of repetition
sections.content: You already know naponta ("daily", from nap + -nta) for repeating every day. -nként works the same way but lets you name any unit: percenként ("every minute", from perc "minute"), óránként ("every hour", from óra "hour"). Add a number in front for a specific interval: tíz percenként ("every ten minutes").

items.english: The bus comes every ten minutes.

items.spanish: A villamos óránként csak kétszer jár.
items.english: The tram only runs twice an hour.

sections.content: -nként always attaches to a plain noun, not a possessive or case-marked one: percenként, not percbenként. Think of it as its own fixed suffix family, like -szor/-szer/-ször.
